# Genially

> Genially is an online platform to create interactive and animated content without coding: presentations, infographics, gamified activities, e-learning courses and more. Used by 46M+ people in 190+ countries, including 11M+ teachers, with 130M+ creations and 18M+ teams in education and business.

Genially works in the browser. Every element can have interactions, animations and hidden content. Creations can be shared by link, embedded in websites and LMSs (Moodle, Canvas, Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams) or exported (PDF, JPG, MP4 video, QR, SCORM, xAPI). It includes AI tools to generate content and 1,300+ templates, 1,100+ of them free. The interface is available in English, Spanish, French, Italian, German and Portuguese (Brazil); creations can be written in any language.

## Plans

Genially has two families of plans: general plans, and education plans for teachers and schools. Each family ends with a custom-priced plan with its own page (Enterprise and Campus).

Prices are geolocated: the amount and currency shown on the plans pages depend on the visitor's region, so they can differ from country to country. Prices are per month, billed annually. For the exact price in a given region, always check the plans page itself.

### General plans

Overview, team pricing and comparison table: https://genially.com/plans/
- [Enterprise](https://genially.com/plans/enterprise/): custom pricing, the top plan. SSO, custom subdomain, activity tracking, groups and permissions, privacy and AI controls, and a dedicated Success Manager.

### Education plans

For teachers and schools; students join a teacher's workspace for free. Overview and comparison table: https://genially.com/plans/education/
- [Campus](https://genially.com/plans/campus/): custom pricing, the top plan, for schools, universities and institutions. SSO, custom subdomain, groups and permissions, the highest AI credit limit, onboarding and a dedicated Success Manager.
- [Plans for students](https://genially.com/plans/students/): student prices, from 1.25 € (StudentPro) in euros; other regions may see a different amount.

## Features

- [All features](https://genially.com/features/)
- [Genially AI](https://genially.com/features/ai/): generate texts, images, questions and whole creations, summarize and translate. See also [generate with AI](https://genially.com/features/generate-with-AI/) and the [AI builder](https://genially.com/features/ai-builder/).
- [Interactions and animations](https://genially.com/features/interactions-and-animations/): turn static content into interactive experiences.
- [Quiz builder](https://genially.com/features/quiz-builder/): interactive questions, assessments and surveys.
- [Present and play live](https://genially.com/features/present-and-play-live/): quizzes and games with real-time audience participation.
- [Analytics and assessment](https://genially.com/features/analytics-and-assessment/): how people engage with your content.
- [LMS integration](https://genially.com/features/lms-integration/): SCORM, xAPI and LTI, with scores synced to LMS gradebooks.
- [Collaboration and team management](https://genially.com/features/collaboration-and-team-management/): live co-editing and administrator controls.
- [Brand kit](https://genially.com/features/brand-kit/): consistent, on-brand content for teams.
- [Sharing and publishing](https://genially.com/features/sharing-and-publishing/): links, embeds, downloads and privacy settings.
- [Accessibility](https://genially.com/features/accessibility/): interactive content that is accessible to everyone.

## Who uses Genially

- [Schools](https://genially.com/solutions/for-schools/): interactive lessons and gamified activities.
- [Higher education](https://genially.com/solutions/higher-education/): course materials and student engagement.
- [Business](https://genially.com/solutions/business/): training, onboarding, sales and internal communication.
- [E-learning authoring](https://genially.com/solutions/elearning-authoring-tool/): authoring tool for instructional designers.
- [Customer stories](https://genially.com/customer-stories/): how [Intel](https://genially.com/customer-stories/intel/), [Holcim](https://genially.com/customer-stories/holcim/), [Santillana](https://genially.com/customer-stories/santillana/) and others use Genially.

## What you can create

- [Interactive presentations](https://genially.com/create/presentations/): presentations with animations, clickable elements and embedded media.
- [Infographics](https://genially.com/create/infographics/): interactive data and visual explanations.
- [Escape rooms](https://genially.com/create/escape-room/): gamified challenges for classes and training.
- [Online courses](https://genially.com/create/online-courses/): e-learning modules with interactive content.
- [Scenario-based learning](https://genially.com/create/scenario-based-learning/): branching scenarios for training.
- [Interactive images](https://genially.com/create/interactive-images/): images and diagrams with clickable hotspots.
- [Interactive maps](https://genially.com/create/interactive-maps/): maps with data and clickable regions.
- [Timelines](https://genially.com/create/timeline/): interactive timelines.
- [Mind maps](https://genially.com/create/mind-maps/): interactive mind maps and concept maps.
- [Flashcards](https://genially.com/create/flashcards-flipcards/): flip cards for learning and review.
- [Choice boards](https://genially.com/create/choice-boards/): activities students choose from.
- [Video presentations](https://genially.com/create/video-presentations/): presentations with interactive video.
- [Pitch decks](https://genially.com/create/pitch-deck/) and [digital brochures](https://genially.com/create/digital-brochures/): interactive business documents.
- [All formats](https://genially.com/create/)

## For developers

- [Genially Developer Center](https://developers.genially.com/): REST API for large organizations to build on Genially. Search and browse team content (spaces, folders and geniallys), read the detail of a genially, read tracking analytics of published geniallys (per-user sessions and question answers, or aggregated visits) and receive webhooks (slide views, interactive question answers, LTI sessions). Authentication with OAuth 2.1 or personal and team access tokens; the API is versioned (v1) and served over HTTPS. Access is limited to large clients.

## Security and privacy

- [Trust center](https://genially.com/trust-center/): SOC 2 Type 2 certified, GDPR compliant, aligned with FERPA and COPPA. Data stored in the European Economic Area (AWS, Ireland).
- [Genially and AI](https://genially.com/trust-center/ai/): how AI features handle your data.

## Genially compared

- [Genially vs Kahoot](https://genially.com/compare/genially-vs-kahoot/)
- [Genially vs Mentimeter](https://genially.com/compare/genially-vs-mentimeter/)
- [Genially vs Nearpod](https://genially.com/compare/genially-vs-nearpod/)
- [Genially vs Articulate](https://genially.com/compare/genially-vs-articulate/)
- [Best authoring tools](https://genially.com/compare/best-authoring-tools/)

## Optional

- [Templates](https://genially.com/templates/): 1,300+ interactive templates, 1,100+ of them free.
- [Community templates](https://genially.com/community/templates/): creations shared by other users.
- [Webinars](https://genially.com/webinars/)
- [Help center](https://help.genially.com/)
- [Partners](https://genially.com/partners/)
